study_identification_part.si_4_title: Nomograms of human hippocampal volume shifted by polygenic scores

nm2_1_modeling_methods.detail: Gaussian process regression (GPR) used to build hippocampal volume nomograms; compared against a sliding window method.
nm2_1_modeling_methods.supporting_text: Using imaging data from 35,686 healthy subjects aged 44-82 from the UK Biobank (UKB), we built HV nomograms using Gaussian process regression (GPR)

nm2_2_response_variable.detail: Hippocampal volume (left, right, and mean/bilateral) modeled as the response variable.
nm2_2_response_variable.supporting_text: Hippocampal volume (HV) is a key endophenotype for many brain disorders.

nm2_3_explanatory_variables.detail: Age used to model hippocampal volume trajectories across the lifespan (nomograms generated across age).
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.supporting_text: In our application it is a distribution of possible 'HV trajectories across age'.
nm2_3_explanatory_variables.location: Janahi2022.pdf.md: Our proposed approach uses GPR to build nomograms
